path_policy.registry_root: Directory containing longitudinal/registry.json; all registered artifact paths are relative to this root.
path_policy.upstream_paths: May appear only as non-clickable provenance strings with path_is_linkable=false.

required.snapshot_date: YYYY-MM-DD; observed collection date, not registration date.
required.parser_version: Stable parser/normalizer identifier; include source code SHA256 in parser_provenance when available.
required.scope: Object describing company channels, portal pages, region, job types, queries, page range and known limits.
required.collection_completeness: Object; must allow unknown/partial and must not infer complete from observed row count.
required.expected_counts: Optional object checked against corpus scan: record_count, body_count, requirements_available_count.

optional.legacy_skill_dictionary_version: Required for legacy skills fallback comparisons.
optional.technology_extractor_version: Required with a technology index unless the index itself carries extractor_version.
optional.technology_extractor_sha256: Optional source extractor code SHA256; must match extractor_sha256 in the index when both exist.
optional.technology_dictionary_sha256: Optional source dictionary SHA256; must match dictionary_sha256 in index when both exist.
optional.technology_rules_sha256: Optional matching/rule implementation SHA256; checked across snapshots.
optional.technology_parser_sha256: Optional technology parser SHA256; checked across snapshots.
optional.technology_index_parser_version: Optional exact technology-index parser version, checked when available.
optional.source_corpus_sha256: If present, must equal input source file bytes.
optional.city_catalog_sha256: If present, must equal --city-catalog input bytes.
optional.company_scope: List of company names intended to be covered.
optional.parser_provenance: Version strings and/or source file names and hashes; source paths are not links.
optional.failures: Observed source/API/pagination/detail failures with scope and resolution status.
optional.upstream_provenance: Source names, hashes, sizes, and path_is_linkable=false; no absolute output links.
optional.synthetic_fixture: Must be false or omitted for real registration.

required.terms: Array of objects with unique id and name; category and aliases may also be retained.
required.jobs: Object keyed by normalized corpus id. Its key set must exactly equal corpus id set.
required.jobs_entry: Each value has requirement, duty, and fulltext arrays of unique term IDs.

optional_fingerprints.extractor_version: Exact extractor version checked across snapshots.
optional_fingerprints.parser_version: Exact index parser version checked across snapshots.
optional_fingerprints.snapshot_date: If present, must equal the registered snapshot date.
optional_fingerprints.source_corpus_sha256: If present, must equal source corpus input bytes before gzip conversion.

technology_index.comparison_default: jobs[id].requirement; matched-job comparison uses stable key (company, source_job_id) and finds vectors by each snapshot's corpus id.

corpus_ndjson_record.preservation: The source corpus is archived byte-for-byte when already gzip; plain NDJSON is deterministically gzipped. Original row fields, full text, source_job_id, text_sha256, and per-source values are preserved.
corpus_ndjson_record.missingness: Unknown, absent, inaccessible, list-only and unparsed are distinct from explicit empty/zero values. A skill mention is not a hard eligibility requirement.

fields.source_catalog_sha256: SHA256 of catalog used to derive the mapping.
fields.source_catalog_record_count: Catalog row count checked against corpus ids.
fields.by_job_id: Object mapping corpus id to exact city_tags array; empty array means unknown/unmatched, not remote.

city_tags_archive.note: Only the id-to-city_tags mapping is archived. Historical tags are reused during re-extraction; never recompute from future catalogs.

fields.snapshots: Object keyed by observed snapshot date.

snapshot_entry.is_baseline: True only when registered into an empty registry.
snapshot_entry.manifest: {path, sha256}; path is relative to registry root.
snapshot_entry.summary: {path, sha256}; path is relative to registry root.
snapshot_entry.corpus: {path, sha256, bytes, source_sha256, source_encoding}; sha256 is archived corpus hash.
snapshot_entry.technology_index: Null or archived index reference and taxonomy fingerprints.
snapshot_entry.city_tags: Null or archived id-to-city-tags mapping reference and source catalog hash.
snapshot_entry.company_count: Number of company names in observed records.
snapshot_entry.technology_dictionary_version: Declared technology taxonomy version or null.

snapshot_manifest.files: Map of artifact role to relative path, bytes and SHA256; all paths resolve inside the archive directory.
snapshot_manifest.failures: Never normalize missing pages, failed details, unknown fields or omitted jobs to zero or closed.

fields.registered_period_count_at_creation: Registry size at write time; not a trend measure.
fields.counts: Single-period body, independent requirements and source-coverage counts.
fields.company_counts: Observed normalized record counts, not total vacancies/HC.
fields.skill_baseline: Single-period n/q counts using the selected dictionary; a skill mention is not a mandatory gate.

filters.city_tags_exact: Exact match against that snapshot's frozen city_tags; legacy fallback is exact source city value only.
filters.direction_contains: Case-insensitive substring over title_direction, job_family, title.

job_changes.newly_observed_in_selected_scope: Present only in current selected observation scope; does not mean a newly opened vacancy.
job_changes.not_reappeared_in_selected_scope: Present only in prior selected observation scope; does not mean the posting was closed.
job_changes.matched_job_changes: Per matched key: full text hash, qualification segment hash, and requirement term additions/removals.

populations.full_sample: Each period's own selected records; denominator can vary.
populations.common_companies: Only companies observed in both periods; job composition and denominator can still vary.
populations.common_matched_jobs: Matched company+source ID cohort; skill n is the intersection with requirement vectors available in both periods.

skill_metric.n: Comparable job records with a readable requirement skill vector.
skill_metric.q: Records in n whose requirement vector contains this term.
skill_metric.prevalence: q/n; not a measure of hiring demand or hard eligibility.

comparison_gates: Technology dictionary version and canonical terms hash must match.
Any declared dictionary/rule/extractor/parser fingerprint or extractor/parser version must match.
If technology index has snapshot_date or source_corpus_sha256, those values must match the snapshot date/source bytes.
Legacy fallback requires both matching legacy skill dictionary version and SHA256.
